episode_title: Gokul Rajaram on the SPADE Decision Making Framework & Product Execution

chunks.content: The SPADE framework brings clarity to high-stakes decisions: Setting, People, Alternatives, Decide, and Explain. First define the Setting (why now?). Assign People (Responsible, Approver, Consulted). List at least 3 viable Alternatives. Make the Decision based on evidence. Explain the rationale transparently to the whole team.
Great execution is about velocity and momentum. Shipping small, high-quality increments consistently beats waiting 6 months for a massive monolithic launch. Feedback loops must be tight.

Focus on a single North Star metric supported by 2-3 input metrics. If your North Star metric is revenue, you're measuring a lagging indicator. Measure the leading user actions that create long-term value.
